paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : figure
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Researcher Location" illustrates the number of datasets contributed by researchers from different countries or regions over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis, labeled "Number of datasets," uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10² (100), with tick marks at 10⁰, 10¹ (10), and 10² (100). Each year is represented by a grouped set of bars, with each bar corresponding to a specific researcher location: "Other" (blue), "UK" (red), "USA" (orange), "IT" (purple), "IN" (green), and "DE" (brown), as indicated in the legend. The data show that the USA consistently contributed a significant number of datasets, particularly from 2016 onward, with peaks around 2017–2019 and again in 2021. The "Other" category shows a sharp increase starting in 2017, reaching the highest values in 2020 and 2021, exceeding 100 datasets. Contributions from the UK, IT, IN, and DE are generally lower and more variable, with some years showing minimal or no contributions. Notably, in 2022, the "Other" category has a very high value (over 100), while the USA, IN, and DE have moderate contributions (around 10), and UK and IT have lower values. The bars are not sorted by height within each year; instead, they are grouped by location and ordered consistently across years. The chart uses a logarithmic scale to better visualize the wide range of dataset counts across years and locations.
